description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection, enabling registration of serialization-related services within the Orleans framework. It defines methods for adding serializer support, as well as internal classes for managing service lifetimes and dependencies related to serialization, such as codecs, serializers, and copiers.

classes.name: ServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to register Orleans serialization services.

classes.name: ConfigurationContext
classes.description: Internal class representing the configuration context during service registration.

classes.name: SerializerBuilder
classes.description: Builds and holds service registration configuration for serializers.

classes.name: ActivatorHolder<T>
classes.description: Generic class implementing IActivator<T> that holds an instance of an activator provider.

classes.name: FieldCodecHolder<TField>
classes.description: Generic class implementing IFieldCodec<TField> that holds a codec provider.

classes.name: BaseCodecHolder<TField>
classes.description: Generic class implementing IBaseCodec<TField> that holds a base codec provider.

classes.name: ValueSerializerHolder<TField>
classes.description: Generic class implementing IValueSerializer<TField> that holds a serializer provider.

classes.name: CopierHolder<T>
classes.description: Generic class implementing IDeepCopier<T> holding a deep copier provider.

classes.name: BaseCopierHolder<T>
classes.description: Generic class implementing IBaseCopier<T> that holds a base copier provider.

classes.name: IServiceHolder<T>
classes.description: Internal interface to hold references to a service instance.

methods.name: AddSerializer
methods.description: Extension method to add serializer support services to the provided IServiceCollection.

methods.name: GetFromServices
methods.description: Internal helper method to retrieve a service instance from the IServiceCollection by type.
